strength: Cheap, 3-player-only shared-contract structure with rotating roles; seat balance already near target (4.3 pts).
weakness: The exact-Target twist succeeds only ~20% of rounds, so the Double-Crosser bonus is nearly free and greedy trick-grabbing beats the intended strategy.
required_changes: Make the Target reachable (+/-1 band with reduced bonus, or DC bonus 2 and higher crew bonus): contract success 40-60%, greedy no longer dominant
Rebalance roles (stronger Swap or Safecracker loot bonus): Safecracker vs Double-Crosser points per round within ~1
Make Heat bite (-2 or loot penalty) or cut it: lead changes >= 2, runaway leader <= 65%
Remove or give a real payoff to No Trump: zero dead options
Fix rule ambiguities (revoke, Heat with no bonus, pass direction, tiebreaker 1): zero ambiguities at pitch
Re-run seat balance on 4,000+ games: gap <= 5 points
revision_reason: Yes: the diagnosis is clear and the fixes are cheap scoring changes; allow one loop and kill if contract success stays under 35%.
